描述_EN: porcelain dish with broad rim painted in underglaze blue, overglaze enamels and gilding in imitation of imari ware with a central medallion containing a vase of flowers on a terrace, surrounded by three panels with peonies, birds and flowers in the famille verte colour scheme alternating with three of chrysanthemums and prunus blossoms in red and gold on a blue ground. this ware, produced in the kilns of arita in hizen province, was named after the port in western japan from where it was exported to europe during the 17th and 18th centuries. japanese wares in imary style were imitated at the kilns of jingdezhen from the late 17th century. four flower sprays are on the outside. the decoration in underglaze blue, overglaze enamels and gold imitates the characteristic colour scheme and design of japanese export porcelain in imari style. during the kangxi period (1662-1722) chinese imari became a popular export ware for europe, where several factories, in turn, imitated the style during the 18th century. this large dish was produced at the kilns of jingdezhen in southern china in about 1720-1730.
描述_ZN: 瓷盘，宽边，以釉下蓝、釉上彩和镀金的方式模仿伊玛瑞器皿，中央的徽章上有一个露台上的花瓶，周围有三幅粉彩的牡丹、鸟和花，与三幅蓝底的红色和金色的菊花和梅花交替在一起。 该器物产于肥前省的阿里塔窑，以日本西部的港口命名，在17和18世纪，它从那里出口到欧洲。 日本的仿制品从17世纪末开始在景德镇的窑场被仿制。 外侧有四朵花的喷头。 釉下蓝、釉上彩和黄金的装饰模仿了日本伊万里风格的出口瓷器的特色配色和设计。 在康熙年间（1662-1722），中国的伊玛利成为欧洲流行的出口器皿，在18世纪，欧洲的一些工厂反过来模仿了这种风格。 这个大盘子是在1720-1730年在中国南方的景德镇窑场生产的。
